name: ipatool
description: Command-line tool that allows you to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, watchOS, visionOS, and macOS apps on the App Store, and download .ipa or macOS .pkg app packages.

latest_release.name: v2.8.1
latest_release.body:
This release adds parallel downloads and dynamic storefront discovery, and improves authentication and recovery of delisted apps.

* Added parallel download streams for large app packages.
* Added dynamic App Store storefront discovery to support regions missing from the built-in list.
* Improved recovery of previously acquired, delisted iOS apps.
* Improved sign-in errors by displaying Apple's authentication dialogs and links for required account actions.
* Reduced memory usage and startup time, with faster initial setup.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/majd/ipatool/compare/v2.8.0...v2.8.1
